import pandas as pd
# Parse date and time to get weekday and hour
df['일자_dt'] = pd.to_datetime(df['일자'])
df['요일'] = df['일자_dt'].dt.day_name()
# Map English day names to Korean for better display if needed, or keep English. 
# Usually Korean users prefer Korean labels. Let's map them.
day_map = {
    'Monday': '월', 'Tuesday': '화', 'Wednesday': '수', 'Thursday': '목',
    'Friday': '금', 'Saturday': '토', 'Sunday': '일'
}
df['요일'] = df['요일'].map(day_map)

# Extract hour from 시작시각 (text like '10:43')
df['시간대'] = df['시작시각'].str.split(':').str[0].astype(int)
title: 설비 정지 발생 빈도 (요일별 시간대)
